tool.name: alevin-fry generate permit list and collate
tool.command: mkdir input_rad && ln -s '$input_rad' input_rad/map.rad && mkdir permit_list && alevin-fry generate-permit-list --input input_rad --expected-ori '$expected_ori' --output-dir permit_list #if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'knee-distance': --knee-distance #else if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'force-cells': --force-cells $barcode.force_ncells #else if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'valid-bc': --valid-bc '$barcode.bcfile' #else if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'unfiltered-pl': --unfiltered-pl '$barcode.plist' --min-reads $barcode.min_reads #else if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'expect-cells': --expect-cells $barcode.expect_ncells #end if #if $sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.multi_barcode_mode_select == 'yes': --sample-bc-list '$sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.sample_bc_list' #if $sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.sample_names: --sample-names '$sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.sample_names' #end if --sample-correction-mode $sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.sample_correction_mode --sample-bc-ori $sec_advanced_options.multi_barcode_mode.sample_bc_ori #end if && alevin-fry collate --input-dir permit_list --rad-dir input_rad --collation-mode $collation_mode && mkdir -p '$output_dir.extra_files_path/collated_permit_list' && mv permit_list/* '$output_dir.extra_files_path/collated_permit_list'

param.label: Expected orientation
param.help: Discards alignments that do not fit the expected orientation.

param.name: force_ncells
param.label: Number of barcodes to keep
param.help: This amount of the most frequent barcodes will be considered part of the permit list.

param.name: bcfile
param.label: List of true, filtered barcodes
param.help: Barcodes in this list will be considered to correspond to true and filtered cells for this sample.

param.name: plist
param.label: Unfiltered barcode permit list
param.help: List of possible barcodes for the sample, e.g. an external permit list like the 10x v2 or the 10x v3.

param.label: Minimum reads
param.help: Only barcodes occuring at least this many times are retained and considered as present cells.

param.name: expect_ncells
param.label: Expected number of cells
param.help: Value around which a robust cutoff will be chosen.

param.label: Sample barcode list
param.help: File containing known sample/library barcodes (one per line).

param.label: Sample names
param.help: TSV file mapping sample barcodes to human-readable names. One line per barcode/name combination, with the barcode and name separated by a tab.

param.label: Sample correction mode
param.help: Correction mode for sample barcodes. Default value: exact.

param.label: Sample barcode orientation
param.help: Orientation of sample barcodes in the whitelist relative to the read. Default value: forward. Forward = whitelist matches read as-is. Reverse = reverse-complement the whitelist before lookup, e.g. 10x Flex v2.

tool.help:
This tool runs **alevin-fry generate-permit-list** on a RAD file, followed by **alevin-fry collate**.
----
**Input**
- **RAD file** generated by **alevin-fry convert** or by **salmon alevin / piscem**.
----
**Functionality**
- Determines which cell barcodes should be associated with "true" cells, which should be corrected to some "true" barcode, and which should be ignored/discarded. - Alignments that do not fit the expected orientation are filtered out. - The barcode selection methods are mutually exclusive. They are described in detail in the alevin-fry documentation https://alevin-fry.readthedocs.io/en/latest/ - Optional: multi-barcode mode uses an additional sample barcode list to distinguish between multiple samples/libraries. - The resulting permit list is then collated by corrected cell barcode, using either the "two-round" (generalizable) or "fast" (single-pass) collation mode.
----
**Output**
- **Collated permit list (directory)**
The output is used as input for **alevin-fry quant**.
